spec.title: Decisions
spec.description: Every change of the twin, when, and by whom. Manual, from the control panel; Automatic, by the calibrator. The dashed markers on the graphs show the same changes.
The simulated time the twin has reached, the end of its latest window of operation.
The measured power draw (ground truth), OpenDT's prediction, and their gap, in the latest sample.
The mean absolute percentage error of OpenDT's power draw vs. the ground truth, over the last 5 minutes. Red from 10%, the community-accepted error rate.
The CO₂ emitted per hour now, OpenDT's power draw times the carbon intensity of the CO₂ zone.

spec.title: Hosts in use
spec.description: Hosts running at least one job, of all the hosts of the twin. An idle host draws power for nothing.

spec.title: Jobs running
spec.description: Jobs running, of the jobs submitted and not done yet. Green when all run, orange when some wait.

spec.title: Power draw
spec.description: The power draw over time, measured at SURF (ground truth) and predicted by OpenDT.

spec.title: CO₂ emissions vs. carbon intensity
spec.description: The twin's CO₂ emissions and the carbon intensity of its CO₂ zone, over time.

spec.title: Hosts available vs. in use
spec.description: The hosts the twin has and the hosts in use, over time.
